scope: weight-scale tensors of the pinned FP8 artifact ONLY; whole-backbone weight finite-load verification is NOT covered by this receipt and remains a load-time requirement without implementation evidence
procedure: parse the safetensors header (8-byte little-endian length + JSON) of model.safetensors
select every tensor whose key ends with '.weight_scale' (200 tensors; header dtype BF16; per-output-channel shapes [out_features, 1])
read each tensor's byte range at data_offsets + header offset; upcast BF16 to Float32 by zero-extending the 16-bit words into the f32 high halves (exact), then widen to Float64
count values equal to 0.0, values < 0.0, and non-finite values; record min/max over all values
no model code is executed; the pass is an offline data inspection bound to the sha256 above
interpretation: every audited scale value is strictly positive and finite, so a strict scale > 0 load policy admits the artifact; producer zero-amax handling uses a positive dtype epsilon (compressed-tensors 0.19.0 @ 525a7a7b84ebccdbc0db07956338b6f8c851d58f, calculate_qparams)
